example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সাফল্যের পর পাঁচহাত বুক করে ঘুরে বেড়ায়।
গর্বে তার বুক পাঁচহাত হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He walks around with his chest puffed out five hands after his success.
His chest has swollen five hands with pride.
note: Refers to exaggerated chest expansion due to pride, common in expressive Bengali idiom usage.
